QUOTE: "`archivedChannelsViewable(value)` returns `value !== 'false'` (`app/queries/servers/system.ts:304`). Only the exact string `'false'` turns the feature off. Any other value, including a missing one, turns it on."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that a missing value leaves archived channels viewable and only an explicit 'false' turns the feature off.
